pcb-analysis.description: Read-only PCB analysis for KiCadRoutingTools AI skills: may run the repo's checkers/analysis tools and fetch datasheets, but must not modify files. The GUI's headless skill runs select this agent (kicad_routing_plugin/ai_backend.py) as the opencode equivalent of the Claude Code --allowedTools allowlist in that module's CLAUDE_ALLOWED_TOOLS. That list is deliberately NOT restated here: it was, and adding Task to it (#552) made this sentence wrong with nothing to notice. `task` is declared explicitly (#942 S4) because the analysis skills ask for a subagent and this file used to answer neither yes nor no -- the same shape as the omission above, one level down: an undeclared permission is not a decision, it is a decision nobody wrote down.
